title: 第5章 倾城少女胖瘦武将第6章 一切皆是为了余氏
content_zh:
冷院的外墙上，余小蝶穿着一件碎花长裙，后面系着一个可爱的大蝴蝶结，仅有十三四岁的年纪，脸上的稚嫩清晰可见，可即便如此，月光下她的容貌依旧让人忍不住地呼吸停顿。
少女的容颜堪称绝色的美人胚子，脸上的五官精致到无可挑剔，每一处都像是最完美的雕刻艺术，哪怕因为年纪身材略显萝莉，可谁都知道，再过些年她必定是位倾国倾城的绝色祸水！
余小蝶如同蝴蝶般翩然落下，再也忍不住扑在了余烬怀中，仰头看着后者，双眼泛红，俏脸上满是委屈，咬着牙开口：“你怎么现在才回来！”
“都这么大个人了，怎么还是个爱哭鬼！”余烬轻轻刮了刮妹妹的脸颊，忍不住笑道。
“谁是爱哭鬼，我才不会哭。”余小蝶咬紧牙关，强忍着没让泪水滴落，却突然说道：“三年了才回来，哥哥就是个讨厌鬼！”
三年来一直行走在生死之间，在大荒某座无法之地被称为“疯子、狂徒”的某人，破天荒有点愧疚，一时语塞不言。
余小蝶撇了撇嘴嘴，“你怎么不说话？”
余烬苦笑了一声，伸出手一巴掌盖在少女那娇俏的小脑袋上，“三年不见，到底吃了多少糖葫芦，你哥被你压得都喘不过气来了！”
余小蝶闻言气得嘴巴鼓囊，像只生闷气的小河豚，刚假装作势要打，却看见余烬像是变着戏法一般，手中出现一根泛着诱人晶莹光泽的糖葫芦。
“外城麦老头家的手艺，回来时赶得太急，只取到这个，其余的下次带你上街吃个够。”余烬笑道。
余小蝶接过那串糖葫芦，小心翼翼地拿在手里，尝了一口后，脸上终于是露出甜甜的笑容，“不用下次，明日就补上。”
“行。”余烬点头，同时心里松了一口气，幸亏这丫头还跟小时候一般喜欢吃各种甜食，要不然哭起来他真不好应付。
边上的陈青见到这一幕，擦了擦嘴角上的血迹，忍不住开口，“小蝶小姐，三爷说过……”
“陈青姐姐，有什么事以后再说，我哥刚刚回来，我想陪着他。”余小蝶回过头看向陈青，脸上带着笑容。
不知为何面对余小蝶的笑容，陈青慌忙低下头去，“好，都听小姐的。”
“哥，我们回屋里，你快说说，你这三年到底跑哪里去了？”余小蝶抱着余烬的手臂，少女笑颜如花，倾城绝色。
然而就在此时，院外忽然响起敲门声，紧接着一个浑厚的声音开腔道：“虎咆营苏三两，受命来请余烬少爷，走一趟！”
树下打盹的黄皮老狗异常人性化地愣了一下，然后后知后觉地朝着门外呲牙狂吠。
余小蝶脸色一沉，余烬抬头看向门外。
低着头的陈青脸色忽然变幻，虎咆营武将，余氏麾下最让人恐惧的存在之一，里面全是从余氏强者中筛选出来，一等一的战力怪物！

“虎咆营的人……为什么会来找我，难道是……”余烬眼中一闪。
余小蝶摁住余烬手臂，轻声道：“哥哥，若不喜欢，就不去。”
“没事，我也好奇虎咆营的人找我做什么？”余烬轻轻松开妹妹的手，一如从前宠溺地揉了揉对方的脑袋后，才优哉游哉地朝外面走去，“在家里等着，我很快就回来，。”
等到余烬走出冷院，才发现外面站的是两个人，他好奇地打量了俩人一眼。
门外的二人组一瘦一胖，一个如竹竿，一个像皮球，加之身上各自套着一副武将盔甲，形象对比既强烈，又略感滑稽，让人忍俊不禁。
可余烬脸上却没有笑容，能瞒过黄皮老狗靠近冷院的人，实力恐怕非比寻常！
“您就是余烬少爷吧？”那胖子满脸笑容可掬，“小的虎咆营苏三两，这位是我兄弟何千斤。”
听见这二人组的名字，余烬眉头动了一下，这才点了点头。
“你跟他废话那么多做什么，侯府上上下下谁不知道他什么处境，一个余氏弃子，别耽误功夫，让他赶紧跟我们走。”名为何千斤的瘦子靠在墙上，双手抱胸，斜睥了余烬一眼，眉宇中尽是不耐烦。
余烬道：“你们要带我去哪里？”
何千斤微微哼了一声，“小子，你不用管去哪里，也别问为什么，跟着走就是，我只问你一句，你打得过我们吗？”
“打不过。”余烬点了点头，“但是，可以试试。”
何千斤眯起眼睛，重新注视着余烬，秋风在冷院外的小巷里吹拂，俩人瞪着眼互不相让。
苏三两笑容满面地拦在二人中间，“我兄弟就是个急性子，余烬少爷别见怪，既然是虎咆营，那找您的是谁，少爷心里大概有个琢磨就是，其余的我不知道也就不多嘴了，来，咱兄弟俩给少爷领路，少爷您请。”
content_en:
On the outer wall of the cold courtyard, Yu Xiaodie was wearing a floral dress with a cute big bow tied at the back. She was only thirteen or fourteen years old, and the childishness on her face was clearly visible, but even so, her appearance under the moonlight still made people stop breathing.
The girl's face is a stunning beauty. The facial features on her face are exquisite and impeccable. Every part of her face is like the most perfect sculpture art. Even if her figure is slightly loli due to her age, everyone knows that in a few years she will be a stunning beauty who will conquer the country!
Yu Xiaodie fell gracefully like a butterfly, and couldn't help but threw herself into the embrace of Ember. She looked up at the latter, her eyes were red, and her pretty face was full of grievances. She gritted her teeth and said, "Why are you coming back now!"
"You're such a big man, why are you still a crybaby!" Yu Yan gently scratched his sister's cheek and couldn't help laughing.
"Who is a crybaby? I won't cry." Yu Xiaodie gritted her teeth and resisted the tears from falling, but suddenly said: "It's been three years since I came back, and my brother is a nuisance!"
For the past three years, someone who has been walking between life and death, and who was called a "madman, a fanatic" in a lawless place in the wilderness, felt a little guilty for the first time and was speechless for a moment.
Yu Xiaodie curled her lips, "Why don't you speak?"
Yan Yan gave a bitter smile, stretched out his hand and slapped the girl's pretty little head, "We haven't seen each other for three years. How many candied haws have we eaten? Your brother was so overwhelmed by you that he couldn't even breathe!"
When Yu Xiaodie heard this, her mouth bulged with anger, like a sulking little pufferfish. She was just pretending to fight, but she saw Ember, like a magic trick, appearing in her hand with a candied haws with an alluring crystal luster.
"Old man Mai's craftsmanship in the outer city. I was in a hurry when I came back. I only got this. I will take the rest to you to eat on the street next time." Yu Jin said with a smile.
Yu Xiaodie took the bunch of candied haws and held it carefully in her hand. After taking a bite, a sweet smile finally appeared on her face, "No need to do it next time, I'll make it up tomorrow."
"Okay." Yi Yan nodded, feeling relieved at the same time. Fortunately, this girl still likes to eat all kinds of sweets like she did when she was a child. Otherwise, it would be difficult for him to handle crying.
When Chen Qing saw this scene, he wiped the blood on the corner of his mouth and couldn't help but say, "Miss Xiaodie, the third master said..."
"Sister Chen Qing, let's talk about it later. My brother has just come back and I want to accompany him." Yu Xiaodie turned back to look at Chen Qing with a smile on her face.
For some reason, facing Yu Xiaodie's smile, Chen Qing hurriedly lowered his head, "Okay, I'll listen to the lady."
"Brother, let's go back to the house. Please tell me, where have you been in the past three years?" Yu Xiaodie held Yu Yan's arm. The girl smiled like a flower and was stunningly beautiful.
However, at this moment, there was a sudden knock on the door outside the courtyard, and then a deep voice spoke: "Su Sanliang of the Tiger Roar Camp, I have been ordered to invite Young Master Yu Jin to come over!"
The yellow-skinned old dog taking a nap under the tree was stunned for a moment in an unusually humane manner, and then without realizing it, he bared his teeth and barked at the door.
Yu Xiaodie's face darkened, and Yi Yan raised his head and looked out the door.
Chen Qing's expression suddenly changed with his head lowered. The general of the Tiger Roaring Camp, one of the most feared beings under Yu's command, was all a monster with first-class combat power selected from the strong men of the Yu's!
"Why did the people from Tiger Roar Camp... come to me? Could it be..." A flash appeared in Yi Yan's eyes.
Yu Xiaodie pressed Yu Yan's arm and said softly: "Brother, if you don't like it, you won't go."
"It's okay, I'm also curious about what the people from the Tiger Roar Camp want to do with me?" Yu Jin gently let go of his sister's hand, rubbed her sister's head lovingly as before, and then walked out leisurely, "Wait at home, I'll be back soon."
When Yu Yan walked out of the cold courtyard, he realized that there were two people standing outside. He looked at them curiously.
The two people outside the door are thin and fat, one is like a bamboo pole and the other is like skin.Balls, and each wearing a pair of military armor, the image contrast is both strong and slightly funny, making people laugh.
But there was no smile on Yu Yan's face. The person who could approach Leng Yuan from the yellow-skinned old dog must have extraordinary strength!
"You are Master Yu Jin, right?" The fat man said with a smile on his face, "Little Hubaoying Su Sanliang, this is my brother He Qianjin."
Hearing the names of the duo, Yi Yan frowned and then nodded.
"Why are you talking so much nonsense to him? No one in the Hou family knows what his situation is. He is an abandoned son of the Yu family. Don't waste your time and let him leave with us quickly." The thin man named He Qianjin leaned against the wall, folded his arms, and glanced sideways at Ember, his brows full of impatience.
Ember said: "Where are you taking me?"
He Qianjin snorted slightly, "Boy, you don't need to worry about where you are going, and don't ask why, just follow along. I only ask you, can you beat us?"
"Can't beat it." Yi Yan nodded, "But, you can try."
He Qianjin narrowed his eyes and stared at the embers again. The autumn wind blew in the alley outside Leng Yuan, and the two stared at each other.
Su Sanliang stood between the two of them with a smile on his face, "My brother is very impatient. Don't be offended, Master Yujin. Since this is the Tiger Roar Camp, who is looking for you? The young master probably has an idea in his mind. I don't know the rest, so I won't say much. Come, we two brothers will lead the way for the young master. Master, please."
